chapter: Reflections on Paris guitarists and saxophonists
title: Hawkins blows Honeysuckle Rose and wins over Pigalle
summary: Hawkins, fortified with cognac, played Honeysuckle Rose until the whole of Pigalle crowded around, and Butler predicted he would surprise America.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists

blocks.x: -- Napoleon -- you don't feel it. You just feel good and Hawkins was building those castles and things -- and he was blowing and his little dog come right where he was and stood up and looked at Coleman Hawkins and then jumped up on the table.
Aikiam had to tell him, no, no, Mimile -- he said, no, I'm going to sit here and enjoy every bit of this. And she stayed there and Coleman Hawkins ran all of that stuff.

That's why I knew when he come back to America that something was going to happen to those tenor saxophone players. He had been studying and all of the stuff that he was playing was all that old -- he'd been, had his piano and he had been exposed to all that European music the European progressions and all that. Those classics, we have many things in there for you.

But he was -- he changed it around and he played 'Honeysuckle Rose' and when he got finished, well, all of Pigalle -- see, when they have a big jam session, people will tell everybody in the cabaret -- man, they are having a jam session, you'd better come on over there and so the clients would come out, pay, then come around, get their drinks and pay and come around and hear this.
And we had the clients from the Melody Bar, they was all over there and it was -- and the post office, that's where you get your letters and you get your stamps, everybody

was over there outside and Coleman Hawkins was blowing and sweating and when he got finished, that was it. Everybody -- "Coleman Hawkins." -- (conversation inaudible.) He grunted a little bit. Now, give me a quart of that cognac, and the man gave it to him. And was happy. And everybody was talking about Coleman Hawkins, so I knew that Coleman Hawkins was gonna come over here, he was going to surprise the people.
